now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
now.text: In episode 86, May is replaced by an LMD and trapped in the Framework, until she escapes with her friends.

changes.evidence: Season 4 (episodes 81-86): May's real body is held, plugged into the Framework, at the Superior's base under the Ivanov Oil Platform in the Baltic Sea, and she escapes from there. Siberia belongs to the season 3 mission (episode 57, 'Parting Shot'), not this record. The app has no place for the Baltic oil platform, so only The Framework is kept.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
now.text: In episode 123, Fitz wakes in space, escapes the Chronicoms with Simmons and Enoch, and returns to Earth to fight them.

proposed.text: In episode 123, Fitz wakes in space, escapes the Chronicoms with Simmons and Enoch, and gets home to Earth. When the Chronicoms attack the Lighthouse, Enoch takes him and Simmons into space to plan how to stop them.

changes.evidence: Fitz gets back to Earth in episode 119 ('Collision Course Part Two') by escaping Izel's ship, not to fight the Chronicoms. In episode 123 ('New Life'), when the Chronicom Hunters attack the Lighthouse, Enoch gets Fitz and Simmons out, and the three take the Zephyr to the Theta Serpentis constellation to work on a plan against the Chronicoms.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
now.text: In episode 123, Fitz wakes in space, escapes the Chronicoms with Simmons and Enoch, and returns to Earth to fight them.

changes.evidence: At the end of episode 123 ('New Life'), Fitz leaves Earth with Simmons and Enoch for the Theta Serpentis constellation and stays in hiding there. He is not seen on Earth again until the season 7 finale.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
now.text: In season 1, Fitz finds the drug that revived Coulson and uses it to save Skye. It turns out to come from a blue alien body.

proposed.text: In season 1, Coulson raids the Guest House for the drug that revived him and uses it to save Skye. It turns out to come from a blue alien body.

changes.evidence: In 'T.A.H.I.T.I.' (season 1, episode 14), Coulson leads a small team on a raid of the Guest House to find the drug and save the wounded Skye. Fitz does not find it.
